slides.title: Hook: AI at your fingertips
slides.body: Today, 2026-10-24, this post shows a practical AI use you can try for learning, planning, writing, creativity, and checking answers.

slides.title: Learn with AI
slides.body: Ask AI to explain a concept in plain language, then summarize key ideas in your own words.

slides.title: Plan with AI
slides.body: Draft a simple study plan or project timeline with AI, then adjust based on your schedule.

slides.title: Write with AI
slides.body: Use AI to outline an email, article, or report, then customize the draft in your voice.

slides.title: Spark creativity
slides.body: Suggest ideas for a project, storytelling prompts, or visual concepts to jumpstart your imagination.

slides.title: Check AI answers
slides.body: Ask to verify steps or sources, then cross-check against known references in your notes.

slides.title: Save and try today
slides.body: Save this post and test one AI tip this week.
